origin.author: jmeter-rs project
origin.description: Hand-authored one-thread, one-iteration finite resource-design plan with 16 short lines and one CSV row; no output write or network input is part of the design.

license.repository_notice: LICENSE and NOTICE at repository root
license.upstream_distribution_use: Apache JMeter is an external pinned oracle only; no upstream plan, result, binary, or machine path is redistributed.

future_recording.target_triple: required on a future oracle run
future_recording.os_image: required on a future oracle run

jvm_charset_requirement.verification: A future oracle runner must verify JVM file.encoding=UTF-8 before execution; this static corpus does not infer it from the process locale.

runtime.hostname_policy: not asserted; hostname saving is disabled
runtime.jmeter_classpath: profile-pinned Apache JMeter 5.6.3 distribution (SHA-512 checked; PGP verification required before oracle use) when an oracle run is explicitly requested
